draft.protocol:
Phase II Study of Drug X in Treatment-Resistant Patients

Objective: To evaluate the efficacy and safety of Drug X in patients with treatment-resistant disease

Study Design: Single-arm, open-label, multicenter phase II trial

Population: Adults (18-75 years) with treatment-resistant disease who have failed at least two prior systemic therapies

Treatment: Drug X administered orally twice daily at 200 mg per dose

Primary Endpoint: Objective response rate assessed by RECIST 1.1 criteria

Secondary Endpoints: Progression-free survival, overall survival, safety and tolerability

Sample Size: 60 patients

Duration: 24 months (including 6 months follow-up)

Estimated Enrollment: 60 patients over 18 months

Investigator Signature: Dr. Sarah Chen, MD

IRB Approval: Required prior to enrollment

Data Monitoring: Independent Data Monitoring Committee

Statistical Analysis: Descriptive statistics for efficacy; safety analysis by treatment-emergent events
